notes: A profile origin is appended to the common back stack only when the requested destination actually becomes visible from cache or observer success.
A request that fails before showing its destination, including one that replaces another pending opening, leaves the visible origin with no phantom history entry.
A cached destination that became visible before its refresh failed retains the real origin and returns to it normally.
This hermetic reduction does not rerun or replace the existing Android, Web and iOS PROF-ENTRY evidence and does not certify deep backend retry or unrelated profile navigation paths.
After the report-targeting candidate was rebased, this product patch retained stable patch-id f20128541e63e4003d30e4457ece1fa5fee58a96 and the affected Wasm test was rerun on the new Product SHA.
